titulo: What a daily $5 coffee really costs in a year
receta: cuenta simple con la plata de todos los días + regla para guardar (precio diario x 365)
destinatario: Se lo manda alguien que lleva la cuenta de sus gastos a su amigo que compra un café todas las mañanas.

interaccion.guardar: Any daily price x 365 = yearly cost. $1 a day = $365 a year. $5 a day = $1,825.
interaccion.comentar: How many coffees do you buy in a week? Give me a number.

frases.texto: That five-dollar coffee you grab every morning? It's not five dollars.
It's eighteen hundred twenty-five dollars a year.
frases.estilo: Dry and punchy, with a half smile.

frases.texto: Five dollars, times three hundred sixty-five days. That's the math.
Even on weekdays only, two hundred sixty days, it's thirteen hundred dollars.
Heads up: no lecture here. If it makes your day, it's worth it.
The trick to save: any daily price, times three sixty-five. One dollar a day is three hundred sixty-five.
Save this for the next time you say, it's just a few bucks.
So how many coffees do you buy a week? Give me a number.
Send this to the friend whose coffee order has six modifiers.
